candidates.title: Ancient Egypt Unveiled: Treasures from Egyptian Museums
candidates.blurb: Egyptian state collections in West Kowloon; Hong Kong's expanding museum diplomacy extends south of Suez.

candidates.title: Treasures of the Mughal Court from the Victoria and Albert Museum
candidates.blurb: V&A Mughal holdings positioned within the Palace Museum's East-West cultural exchange programme.

candidates.title: Wonders of Imperial Carpets: Masterpieces from the Museum of Islamic Art, Doha
candidates.blurb: Qatari imperial carpets alongside Qing textiles; a pointed pairing of dynastic material culture.

candidates.title: A Movable Feast: The Culture of Food and Drink in China
candidates.blurb: Chinese culinary material culture examined through Palace Museum vessels and serving implements.

candidates.title: The Forbidden City and The Palace of Versailles
candidates.blurb: Parallel court cultures in Beijing and Paris; early modern diplomatic and aesthetic exchange.

candidates.title: A History of China in Silk: The Chris Hall Collection
candidates.blurb: Private Western collection of Chinese textiles donated to the Palace Museum; questions of provenance and return.

candidates.title: The Art of Armaments: Qing Dynasty Military Collection
candidates.blurb: Imperial weaponry as decorative art; Qing military aesthetics without martial narrative.

candidates.title: Fermata: Hong Kong in Venice
candidates.blurb: Hong Kong's Venice Biennale collateral event restaged locally; a mirror of the city's international cultural ambitions.

candidates.title: Live: Hong Kong Art Exhibition
candidates.blurb: Institutional survey of contemporary Hong Kong practice; tone and selection will reveal curatorial confidence.

candidates.title: Proudly from Canton: The Muwen Tang Collection of Cantonese and Export Art
candidates.blurb: Private collection of Canton export ware; Hong Kong reconnects to its Pearl River Delta trade history.

candidates.title: Alicja Kwade: Waiting Pavilions
candidates.blurb: Kwade's sculptural interventions in the colonial prison yard; international contemporary art against Hong Kong's carceral architecture.

candidates.title: Tai Kwun Neon Connection
candidates.blurb: Neon heritage project in a heritage-industry complex; the city's vernacular signage recontextualised as cultural asset.
